sn34.7:1.5: One meditator is skilled in projecting the mind purified by immersion but not in immersion.
sn34.7:1.6: One meditator is skilled neither in immersion nor in projecting the mind purified by immersion.
sn34.7:1.7: One meditator is skilled both in immersion and in projecting the mind purified by immersion.
sn34.7:1.8: Of these, the meditator skilled both in immersion and in projecting the mind purified by immersion is the foremost, best, leading, highest, and finest of the four.
